evidence: PinnedVersions now derives the parent JSON-pointer path and property name, then removes that property via package.remove_prop.
The split uses the last literal '/', preserving nested parent paths.
gaps: No evidence that PinnedVersions paths are always non-empty, slash-delimited property paths; paths without '/' are silently ignored.
No tests are shown for root-level, nested, malformed, or trailing-slash paths.
